mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.seller_id, s.username AS seller_name, s.shop_name, o.total_amount, o.status, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.receiver_address, o.logistics_company, o.logistics_no, o.shipped_at, o.received_at, o.created_at FROM orders o LEFT JOIN sellers s ON o.seller_id = s.id WHERE o.id = #{id}
